contract: design-contract.md; local research workspace with explicit run modes, inspectable sources, preserved corrections, separate unavailable forecast, and qualified reports.

accessibility.evidence: Playwright/axe reported no violations for desktop research, desktop discovery and mobile research after three muted colours were darkened. Keyboard checks verified skip navigation, citation-to-source focus and return focus on close. Controls have accessible labels and statuses include text. This is not a full screen-reader usability study.

responsive.evidence: Inspected desktop and mobile screenshots. At 390px, document scrollWidth equalled innerWidth, the source panel became static inline content, and a long injected source identifier wrapped without overflow. Reduced-motion media was exercised. Candidate tables use a labelled internal scrolling region.

loading.evidence: Delayed run fetch displayed a named loading state. A running status showed the actual action. A failed poll preserved the report and allowed reconnect without submission; see loading-state.png.

empty.evidence: Research without a run displayed a clear starting action and labelled teaching example; see empty-state.png.

error.evidence: Missing run ID, missing SEC configuration and a connection failure displayed explicit errors with recovery. Lost POST response was recovered after refresh using the same idempotency key; total run count increased by one only. See error-state.png.

partial.evidence: Missing model configuration produced a failed run with saved deterministic metrics, no copied critic review, and an explicit model-review limitation. Refresh/history reopened the same result; see partial-result.png.

success.evidence: Saved synthetic replay displayed source provenance, a recorded mixed-period correction, a supported fact and an explicitly unavailable forecast. Research reload made no POST. Discovery retained pass/fail/unknown outcomes and opened company details.

permission.reason: There is no account or permission UI in this loopback single-user application. Host/origin boundaries and cross-site rejection were verified by API tests, including an explicit local-only 403 response.

renderedEvidence.observation: Full-page capture from the desktop viewport: quiet research layout, three aligned metrics, claim statuses, original/objection/check/revision trail, adjacent source desk, separate forecast and limitations.
Declared five-company universe, visible threshold, selection counts, sortable results and explicit unknown/exclusion reasons.
Full-page capture from the mobile viewport: compact navigation, stacked controls and metrics, wrapping report text and inline source inspector without document horizontal overflow.
Financial calculations remain available when model review fails; failure and qualification are visible.
Initial loading state has named feedback and does not invent progress.
Empty research workspace offers a clear first action.
Missing-run error provides a visible recovery control.

validation.backend: 21 tests passed, including idempotency/concurrency, restart, scope, immutable evidence, Eastern/DST cutoff handling, structured model-output handling and API boundaries.
validation.browser: All 8 browser acceptance scenarios passed. The 3 research/discovery/mobile scenarios were rerun successfully against a clean test database after the final report-fixture adjustment.
validation.build: TypeScript and Vite production build passed.
validation.limitations: SEC and model integration tests use mocked/recorded responses. No authenticated live-provider smoke test, validated forecasting artifact or full five-role agent evaluation has been completed.
